# VMware world-class pages: UI review shots

Before and after pictures for the UI review of PR #5575. Each `review-<name>-before.png` is the builder's
branch (c78bc7a2f0) and each `review-<name>-after.png` the review, both rendered at 2x by the offline
VMware Pages fixture (`packages/E2E/VMwarePages`: the production vCenter layout, pages, Tailwind, Inter
and locale files over made-up records for an "Acme Virtualization" workspace). Nothing here is a real
customer's data.
